headline.purpose: Section arguments and major content headings.

body.purpose: Evidence-led prose, constrained to a readable measure.

label.purpose: Dates, sources, statuses, and compact navigation labels.

layoutMeta.grid: 12 columns above 840px; one reading column below

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The direct action pattern for sharing or continuing to evidence, with a 44px minimum touch target.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; padding:12px 24px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:4px; background:#0e2d3d; color:#f8fbfc; font:500 .875rem/1.2 Geist Sans,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.005em; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#18465d; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0b6685; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The secondary action pattern, visibly available without competing with the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; padding:12px 24px; border:1px solid #c8d8e0; border-radius:4px; background:transparent; color:#0e2d3d; font:500 .875rem/1.2 Geist Sans,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.005em; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 140ms ease,border-color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:#e8f0f4; border-color:#8aa4b0; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0b6685; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Question Status Flag
components.description: A compact factual state marker for an unanswered question.
components.css: .ds-flag { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:4px 8px; background:#dceef4; color:#126886; font:500 .6875rem/1.4 Geist Mono,ui-monospace,monospace; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-flag i { width:5px; height:5px; background:currentColor; }

components.name: Citation Link
components.description: Publisher-named evidence link, preserving the distinction between reporting and primary material.
components.css: .ds-cite-row { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; align-items:baseline; margin:0; } .ds-cite-row span,.ds-cite-row a { font:.75rem/1.5 Geist Mono,ui-monospace,monospace; } .ds-cite-row span { color:#8aa4b0; font-size:.6875rem; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-cite-row a { color:#587482; border-bottom:1px solid #c8d8e0; text-decoration:none; } .ds-cite-row a:hover { color:#0e2d3d; border-color:#8aa4b0; } .ds-cite-row a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0b6685; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Record Row
components.description: A border-delimited evidence row; this replaces decorative card grids throughout the site.
components.html:
?

What remains unanswered?

The question is stated plainly and linked to evidence.
components.css: .ds-record { display:grid; grid-template-columns:20px 1fr; gap:12px; padding:20px 0; border-top:1px solid #c8d8e0; border-bottom:1px solid #c8d8e0; color:#294857; } .ds-record-mark { color:#126886; font:.8125rem/1.5 Geist Mono,ui-monospace,monospace; } .ds-record h3 { margin:0; color:#0e2d3d; font:600 1rem/1.35 Geist Sans,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.01em; } .ds-record p { margin:8px 0 0; font: .9375rem/1.6 Geist Sans,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; }

components.name: Timeline Docket
components.description: A chaptered public-record chronology with a recurring date axis, selective turning-point emphasis, and one conclusive present-state plane.
components.html:
The unanswered exchange

Parliament asks who authorised Acus. The answers stop short.

  1. 6 November 2025

    Written question 2025/26:167

    The question enters the public record.

  2. 19 November 2025

    The minister answers — without answering

    The timing and storage questions are not addressed.
components.css: .ds-docket { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(12,minmax(0,1fr)); column-gap:clamp(24px,3vw,40px); padding:48px 0 96px; border-top:1px solid #0e2d3d; } .ds-docket>header { grid-column:1/5; } .ds-docket>ol { grid-column:5/-1; margin:0; padding:0; list-style:none; border-top:1px solid #c8d8e0; } .ds-docket li { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(8,minmax(0,1fr)); column-gap:clamp(24px,3vw,40px); padding:32px 0; border-bottom:1px solid #c8d8e0; } .ds-docket time { grid-column:1/3; font:.8125rem/1.5 Geist Mono,ui-monospace,monospace; color:#0e2d3d; } .ds-docket article { grid-column:3/-1; } .ds-docket h2,.ds-docket h3,.ds-docket p { margin:0; } .ds-docket .is-turning { padding:48px 0; } @media(max-width:839px){.ds-docket{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:32px}.ds-docket>header,.ds-docket>ol{grid-column:1}.ds-docket li{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:12px;padding:24px 0}.ds-docket time,.ds-docket article{grid-column:1}}

components.name: Documentary Pull Quote
components.description: A ministerial quotation paired with its documentary portrait; it stacks on narrow viewports and never crops the photograph.
components.css: .ds-quote { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.15fr) minmax(300px,.85fr); align-items:center; gap:clamp(32px,5vw,72px); margin:0; padding-top:clamp(28px,3.5vw,44px); border-top:2px solid #0e2d3d; } .ds-quote blockquote { margin:0; color:#0e2d3d; font:500 clamp(1.5rem,3.2vw,2.375rem)/1.24 Geist Sans,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.022em; } .ds-quote img { display:block; width:100%; height:auto; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid #c8d8e0; border-radius:12px; filter:saturate(.9) contrast(.98); } @media(max-width:819px){.ds-quote{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

components.name: Press Card
components.description: Auto-height photographic coverage record with an approved publication mark and complete, unclipped context.

components.css: .ds-press { display:flex; min-width:0; flex-direction:column; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid #c8d8e0; border-radius:8px; background:#fff; color:#294857; text-decoration:none; font-family:Geist Sans,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-press-photo { position:relative; aspect-ratio:16/9; overflow:hidden; } .ds-press-photo>img { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; filter:saturate(.72); } .ds-press-body { display:flex; min-width:0; flex:1; flex-direction:column; padding:18px 20px 20px; } .ds-press-logo { width:auto; max-width:132px; height:25px; object-fit:contain; object-position:left; } .ds-press strong { margin-top:12px; color:#0e2d3d; font-size:clamp(1.125rem,1.6vw,1.375rem); line-height:1.3; overflow-wrap:anywhere; } .ds-press small { margin-top:8px; color:#4d6877; font-size:.875rem; line-height:1.55; overflow-wrap:anywhere; } .ds-press em { align-self:flex-start; margin-top:auto; padding-top:18px; color:#126886; border-bottom:1px solid currentColor; font-size:.875rem; font-style:normal; font-weight:600; } .ds-press:hover { border-color:#8aa4b0; } .ds-press:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0b6685; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Campaign Artwork Placeholder
components.description: A localized neutral-gray frame that reserves the final campaign artwork's exact aspect ratio and displays its recommended export dimensions.
components.css: .ds-art-slot { display:grid; place-items:center; aspect-ratio:4/5; min-width:0; margin:0; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid #c8d8e0; border-radius:12px; background:#d7dcdf; color:#34444c; } .ds-art-slot figcaption { display:grid; justify-items:center; gap:4px; padding:24px; text-align:center; } .ds-art-slot span { font:400 .9375rem/1.45 Geist Sans,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-art-slot strong { font:500 .8125rem/1.4 Geist Mono,ui-monospace,monospace; } .ds-art-slot small { font:400 .75rem/1.4 Geist Sans,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: A calm, evidentiary campaign system that reads like a well-kept public file rather than a political poster. North Sea blues, structural hairlines, source-level metadata, and restrained photography make claims easy to read and check.
keyCharacteristics: A recurring 12-column evidence grid establishes recognizable alignment.
Standard route heroes share one compact title-and-lead baseline.
Evidence figures and sources read as horizontal public-record registers rather than dashboards or list dumps.
A large Night Record footer turns the campaign question into the final statement.
Clear blue communicates action and unresolved state.
Three purposeful campaign-artwork slots reserve key visual moments without interrupting evidence.
Press coverage uses static photographic records with approved SVG marks and complete copy.

rules.name: The Calm Signal Rule
rules.body: Stronger blue communicates action or unresolved state without performing alarm. It may be used for links and focus, but never as decorative noise.

rules.name: The Evidence Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: A claim is sans; the evidence that locates it is mono. Do not reverse this relationship.

rules.name: The Line-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate information with a hairline or a tonal surface. Do not add shadows to cards, lists, buttons, or notices.

rules.name: The Plain Heading Rule
rules.body: Page and section headings stand on their own. Do not add eyebrow labels, decorative section numbers, or ornamental arrows.

rules.name: The Shared Axis Rule
rules.body: Narrow prose may retain a readable measure, but it sits asymmetrically inside the evidence grid rather than floating between full-width sections.

dos: Do use blue-tinted hairlines, measured whitespace, and a maximum content width of 1180px to make long material easy to verify.
Do align heroes, section rails, evidence fields, and press introductions to the shared 12-column grid.
Do use the 4pt component spacing scale, the 4/8/12px radius scale, and role-based section padding.
Do preserve the 4:5 Home and Questions slots, the 3:2 Acus slot, and both share-export ratios when replacing placeholders.
Do use the stronger blue consistently for actions, focus, unanswered questions, and the current political state.
Do show every press article with a photograph, approved SVG publisher mark, complete description, and direct external link.
Do keep Home's press register compact and About's press archive complete.
Do let headlines and summaries wrap to their full length at every viewport.
Do keep compact controls at least 44px.
Do honour reduced motion: reveal content must be visible without animation and instantly readable for reduced-motion users.
donts: Don't make it look like party-political propaganda.
Don't add social-justice-warrior signalling, moralising iconography, or outrage-first visual treatment.
Don't use the visual language of a SaaS technology company.
Don't invite whistleblowing, leaked information, source submissions, or private contact anywhere on the site.
Don't turn press coverage into a carousel or moving rail.
Don't use eyebrow labels, decorative 01/02/03 numbering, ornamental arrows, or text truncation.
Don't stack two full section paddings between adjacent modules.
Don't default unrelated content to equal-width compartments.
Don't add campaign-artwork placeholders to Known, Timeline, or About, and don't round structural record rows.
